title: Adding an activity-logged model: scope list, light receiver module, ready() wiring, baseline, generated types
answers: How do I add activity logging for a new model in a product app?
Why did setup_receivers baseline test fail after adding a receiver?
Added a new ActivityScope and generated api.schemas.ts / mcp generated.ts changed
body:
Adding a model with activity logging (e.g. TracesRetentionRule) touches these together:
- Model uses `ModelActivityMixin` (products/tracing/backend/models.py:TracesRetentionRule).
- Add model name to the scope list in posthog/models/activity_logging/activity_log.py (ActivityScope literal).
- Receiver in a dedicated light module products/tracing/backend/activity_logging.py:handle_traces_retention_rule_activity, using `@mutable_receiver(model_activity_signal, sender=Model)`. No viewset/query-runner imports there.
- Import that module in `AppConfig.ready()` (products/tracing/backend/apps.py:TracingConfig.ready) so it is wired in celery/temporal/migrate too.
- Add a `model_activity:<module>.<handler>` line to posthog/test/repo_invariants/setup_receivers_baseline.txt (sorted).
- Regenerate the scope enums: products/platform_features/frontend/generated/api.schemas.ts and services/mcp/src/api/generated.ts (do not hand-edit beyond generation).
applies: Any product model that needs activity-log entries.
